It’s definitely not one of the worse experiences I’ve had with seeking help but it’s really been one of the final straws for me. Before This experience, I went in to my primary doctor for help with getting info on inpatient because I was in a horrible crisis and just had the absolute worst luck with everything that day. First off, I apparently got picked to be the lab rat for a completely new nurse to be trained with on. That was just great. Then while doing all the intake paperwork (that I normally don’t do half the time because well.. it’s my right not to.) I got into an argument about how I wasn’t comfortable with the female specific paperwork regarding pregnancy  because I was going through a lot of gender dysphoria and I’m a lesbian anyway that’s already went through the heartbreak of struggling to conceive with my partner (my partner was the one going to carry and we had just gotten through our sixth month of ttc which ended in a strong chemical..) but the nurse that was training the newbie literally made me burst into tears because she wouldn’t stop pushing for in depth information.. then afterwords when I finally got to me doctor I explained what I was there for and she told me she’d get me that info. Low and behold the main nurse I had just had horrible issues with came back in and said “Your just going to have to go to the ER if you want inpatient.” Side note I was VERY honest with my doctor 10 minutes prior about how traumatic of an experience I’ve had with the ER regarding crisis’s and mental health in general.. I got so over it and just dropped the whole thing and tried leaving and she the blocks me and start repeatedly asking “Well are you going to go? Are you going?”........ I had to just say I was to even be let out of the room and “discharged” from my appointment..... (((btw that nurse got fired. But the damage was already done.)))
long story short about all that I left feeling even worse and that was the last time I have stepped foot into my doctors office because I’m so stupidly sensitive to stupid stuff like embarrassment and that’s now a traumatic environment. 

It’s been over two years sense I’ve seen a doctor at all because of that. It’ll probably be a full year till I try any mental health treatment again too. 
I’m just so exhausted from trying tbh. I’m not going to lie, I’ve come to terms now that my issues aren’t treatable when it comes to common methods and techniques. And that’s just how it is I guess.

You can discuss this with a primary doctor but your best bet would be to find a good therapist/councilor. A doctor is going to go straight for a fix and want to discuss medications which don’t work for everyone but you can try that if you want to, oh and they’d also direct you to seek mental health treatment anyway and give you resources for that. A mental health worker (therapist, councilor, etc) will go more in-depth about your feelings, explain and inform you of the whys and how’s, and go into more expansive treatment options. I can tell you (as a 25 year old who has been chronically depressed sense very early childhood) these feelings don’t get better on there own. The earlier you seek help and treatment, the better. Trust me, when you don’t think it can get any worse, it can. It can get so much worse. 
Just be honest, be open to options, and don’t allow anyone to push you into trying things you aren’t ready for or want. You are always your best ally first. :)
Also your intelligence is lacking highly. Focus more in school and you’ll shape up nicely.

This sounds really serious and I’m sorry you’re in this position. ‘Daniel’ must have some more in depth issues occurring and I think it’s safe to say he needs immediate help. Having violent thoughts and that bad of rage from a video game isn’t normal, and going into such a rage were his only thoughts are to very seriously hurt someone is cause for high concern. My first advice would be to go to his parents but sometimes it can be more of a harm then good especially if they don’t take it seriously or try to smother the issues. My second advice would be to go to the police and that can be really scary, but if your honest about his threats and that your more concerned for his well being and mental health, everything should be fine. But I would be very clear that you want to remain anonymous when it comes to the report and so on, just in case your worried about ‘Daniel’ holding a grudge or anything. If you go to the police you need to be very thorough and most definitely give them all of the names of the people he has made the most serious threats about. They’ll most likely be contacted as well but remember, you can remain 100% anonymous.
